proposal.label: needs reproducible example
proposal.comment: Could you share a small, shareable Parquet sample (or equivalent SQL-generated data) that still triggers the crash, together with the exact command you use to run the script and the complete stderr/backtrace? The provided script references '../raw_metars' which isn’t included, so a minimal reproducible input is needed to follow the failure.
proposal.rationale: The report supplies a SQL script that references external data directory '../raw_metars' but no sample data or generated equivalent is provided, preventing local reproduction of the crash.
